supplemental_items.interpretation: Query every active StopAll from own decision and raw price. Stop<=E decision inclusive. Max number and min exact event independent; count entries; remove by object id, emit then extend active, clear owner/pending.
No stopped active: fresh armed search even if pending, truthy pending prevails; completed emits number1 and appends active (not singleton). Ordinary E accept normalizes family and int number.
Exact S tag otherwise E; process supplied event order, capture optional post-event checkpoint with output length; no local catch, no stop resolve.
